thread.title: Special Participation E: residual connection
thread.content: <document version="2.0"><paragraph>This is my first time using ChatGPT’s Study Mode; I normally rely on the standard interface. I found the experience to be noticeably more interactive and engaging. The model proactively asks follow-up questions that reinforce my understanding, which proves highly effective for learning. For example, when I asked about residual connections, it not only provided a clear explanation but also accurately identified the source of my confusion and addressed it in a targeted way. Overall, Study Mode has been very helpful in deepening my comprehension of complex concepts.</paragraph><file url="https://static.us.edusercontent.com/files/9wlLcyvh2Y5IWCWndgYjMgJA" filename="Special Participation form E-1.pdf"/></document>
thread.document: This is my first time using ChatGPT’s Study Mode; I normally rely on the standard interface. I found the experience to be noticeably more interactive and engaging. The model proactively asks follow-up questions that reinforce my understanding, which proves highly effective for learning. For example, when I asked about residual connections, it not only provided a clear explanation but also accurately identified the source of my confusion and addressed it in a targeted way. Overall, Study Mode has been very helpful in deepening my comprehension of complex concepts.
